title: Show HN: Paint the Earth on a live, interactive globe (collaborative art.)
summary: Earth.tattoo is a collaborative art platform that divides the entire Earth into 510 million 16x16 pixel tiles displayed on a live, interactive 3D globe, allowing users to claim and paint tiles with one free tile per hour.
problem_solved: Provides a global canvas for collaborative digital art where anyone can permanently claim and decorate a piece of virtual Earth.
why_valuable: It democratizes digital art ownership by creating a unique, finite, and shared digital space where people's contributions form a living, evolving artwork visible from space.
